<!-- pr-reviewer: 6523e02e72f2b4d5567b769ab16fbb7bc791902f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This PR does not change posted G-code, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
Parent PR #2662 merged into `upstream/main` during the review, and this branch merges cleanly with `upstream/main`.

### What looks good

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:197-211`: Clicking `Move` turns on both `move_handles` and `rotate_handles` together. Clicking `Rotate` while `Move` is active selects `turn_value` without hiding the arrows or rings.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar_controls.rs:191-198`: `Move value` and `Rotate value` switch the typed editor while keeping both handle sets visible. Live drags call `sync_move_drag` or `sync_turn_drag` to select the matching editor.
- `crates/ui/src/turn_drag.rs:187-218`: `ring_enabled` checks the ring plane angle against `move_drag::END_ON_SIN2`. An edge-on ring consumes the press, writes `edge_on_hint(axis)` to `state.status`, and starts no inert drag.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/move_handles.rs:33-38` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/turn_handles.rs:33-43`: Each handle exposes an AccessKit `Button` node (`Move along X/Y/Z`, `Rotate about X/Y/Z`) and hover text. Edge-on rings get a disabled node with the orbit hint.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/body_turn.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs`: The tests pin the combined gizmo, undo, toolpath staleness, stock following, Shift snapping, typed angles, AccessKit disabled state, and `layout_page_viewport`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs` stays at 295 lines, and `viewport_bar_controls.rs` stays at 303 lines. No production path uses `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()`.
- The PR body includes verified before and after screenshots on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch (`2d067bdfb572e463de92c71cd99f61e315accc40`), `docs/decisions/2624-combined-gizmo.md`, `Changelog:`, and `Fixes #2624`. No snapshot PNGs or `.nc`/`.cl` goldens changed.

### Results merged with main

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2791` with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` (no GitHub runner).

- Trial merge with current `upstream/main` (`f3b0e1955`, which includes #2662 and #2770):
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 9/9 steps passed in 2.9 min (`1311 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored`).
    - `ui build (--no-run)`: passed (19s).
    - `ui suites: lib`: `1275 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored` (142s; `launch_file_tests::a_solidcraft_design_is_imported` >60s).
    - `ui suites: boundary`: `3 passed; 0 failed`.
    - `ui suites: boundary_picks`: `7 passed; 0 failed`.
    - `ui suites: sinker_setup`: `2 passed; 0 failed`.
    - `ui suites: tap_hand`: `3 passed; 0 failed`.
    - `ui suites: theme_example`: `3 passed; 0 failed`.
    - `ui suites: theme_files`: `17 passed; 0 failed`.
    - `ui suites: waterjet_tool`: `1 passed; 0 failed`.
  - Earlier run against `upstream/main` at `744c0847b` (before #2662 merged): all 17/17 quick gate steps passed (`1398 passed; 0 failed; 9 ignored`, including `catalog_render`, `feedback`, `fixtures`, `gpu_render`, `machine`, `models`, `operations`, and `shell`).
  - `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` (on `f3b0e1955` trial merge): passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

Extra suites run:

- Neither `testdata/` nor importer code changed, so the extra fixture and importer rules add no required suites.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --test egui_app -- --test-threads=1` (on `744c0847b` trial merge): `8 passed; 0 failed`.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib model_link_tests` (on `f3b0e1955` trial merge): `3 passed; 0 failed` (re-checked after one parallel run hit a pre-existing timestamp flake in `a_changed_file_is_imported_again_as_one_undo_step_and_its_operations_only_go_stale`).

Mutations checked locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2791` and then restored cleanly:

1. Restored `state.rotate_handles &= !state.move_handles;` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs:203`: `move_gizmo_shows_arrows_and_rings_together` failed (`exit 101`). Restoring the line made the test pass (`1 passed; 0 failed`).
2. Bypassed the `!ring_enabled` guard at `crates/ui/src/turn_drag.rs:215`: `an_edge_on_ring_refuses_the_drag_and_names_the_view_change` failed (`exit 101`). Restoring the guard made the test pass (`1 passed; 0 failed`).
3. Passed `true` instead of `enabled` to `WidgetInfo::labeled` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/turn_handles.rs:35`: `edge_on_ring_accessibility_is_disabled_while_the_visible_ring_stays_enabled` failed (`exit 101`). Restoring `enabled` made the test pass (`1 passed; 0 failed`).

### Requested before merge

None.

### Questions / notes

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/move_handles.rs:33` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/turn_handles.rs:33` (non-blocking): `["X", "Y", "Z"][axis]` and `["X", "Y", "Z"][*axis]` index directly while the line above uses `.get(axis)`. `arms_px` and `rings_px` always emit indices `0..3`, though `.get(...)` keeps indexing defensive.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/model_tools.rs:86-122` (non-blocking): The PR body states that `move_model` already supports a turn with a pivot. `move_model` accepts `position` and a `rotation` quaternion, not a separate `pivot` field; #2514 already tracks whether to add a center-pivot MCP verb, and this PR adds no new app command.
- Note on draft state: PR #2791 stays a draft (`isDraft: true`) for the author or maintainer to mark ready when appropriate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
